invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.

login.title: Sign in
login.hub: Internal demo hub. Client links are /g/<client>, for example /g/shola-mist and /g/lawsome.
login.intro: Use your work email, or open the demo as one of the personas below.
login.noBackend: Password sign-in activates when the Supabase project is connected. This deployment runs in demo mode.
login.demoNote: Demo sessions read sample data only

errors.no_backend: Password sign-in needs the Supabase backend. Use a demo role below.
errors.inactive: Your access was removed by your admin.
errors.no_profile: You are signed in but not invited to a workspace.
errors.revoked: Your access to that workspace was removed. Sign in again.
errors.link: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new invitation or reset your password.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.role: Pick one of the demo roles.
errors.demo_disabled: Demo roles are disabled on this deployment.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lead: Enter your work email and we will send a link if an account exists for it.
reset.sent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. It expires in one hour.

setPassword.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new invitation or reset your password.
setPassword.title: Choose a password
setPassword.hint: Use at least 12 characters. A few random words make a strong passphrase; no symbols or numbers are required, and spaces are fine. Common or leaked passwords are refused.

errors.long: That is too long. Use at most 72 characters.
errors.common: That password is too common or has appeared in leaks. Choose a longer, less predictable passphrase.
errors.context: Do not use your own email name inside the password.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.failed: We could not save that password. Try a different one.

invite.incomplete: This invitation link is incomplete. Ask your admin to send a new one.
invite.title: You have been invited
invite.lead: Accept the invitation, then choose a password to enter your workspace.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.signInFirst: Sign in first, then come back to set up two-step verification.
mfa.setupFailed: We could not start setup. Try again in a minute.
mfa.requiredLead: Your role needs two-step verification before you can open the workspace. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.setupLead: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.codeLead: Open your authenticator app and enter the current 6-digit code.
mfa.badCode: That code was not accepted. Enter the current code from your authenticator.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.cannotScan: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually:
